answer: Stop sybils with a crystal lattice of bonded receipts. Each new identity posts a deposit receipt chained to every receipt its sponsor already issued, so the k-th clone costs k times the base bond and N clones cost roughly N squared in total — no botnet can split that bill. To join, a newcomer must also be vouched for by a relic: an identity with a long honest record, and each relic can sponsor only a few newcomers per epoch. Climb to the summit of trust slowly; a farm that mints a thousand fresh names in one night finds the lattice price rising underfoot and no relic willing to vouch.
